title: TVF's Potions
description: Two new potion types as well as a couple new ways to use potions
body:
A mod that adds two new potion types, as well as a couple new ways to use potions.

Features:
- 2 new potion effects: Enormity and Tininess, which make you larger and smaller respectively. Potion of Enormity is crafted with Bottles o' Enchanting and Potion of Tininess is crafted with Rabbit Hide (like the Vote Update's size-changing potions).
- 1 potion ported from Bedrock: Potion of Decay, which inflicts wither 2 for 40 seconds. (Creative only)
- Amulets: A Lapis Amulet can be used in place of an Awkward Potion in brewing; craft it with 4 Gold Ingots, 2 Gold Nuggets, and 1 Lapis Lazuli. Wear an Amulet in your chest armor slot to get a permanent (until you take it off) potion effect, but of course you can't wear a chestplate or Elytra at the same time.
- Gels: Water Gel can be used in place of an Awkward Potion in brewing; craft it with 1 Water Bucket and 8 Slimeballs. Place Gels on the ground to get their potion effect as long as you're standing on them.

Made with MCreator
